description: Exact PAYG tax an Australian employer must withhold from one pay (weekly, fortnightly, monthly or quarterly) under ATO Schedule 1 (NAT 1004), with Schedule 8 for study loans and Schedule 9 for seniors, for 2025-26 or 2026-27. Use it in payroll code or when declaration details matter: tax-free threshold, TFN, residency, HELP, Medicare levy exemption or family variation, tax offsets. Returns whole dollars to withhold, take-home for the pay, the tax scale and a breakdown. For a whole-salary summary use take_home_pay; for a bonus or commission use bonus_withholding. Working holiday makers aren't supported and return an error. Read-only and deterministic.

annualTaxOffset.description: Total annual tax offsets claimed on the withholding declaration (AUD).

earnings.description: Gross earnings for this pay period in AUD, including taxable allowances and overtime, e.g. 3076.92 for a fortnight.

foreignResident.description: Foreign resident for tax purposes. Default false.

medicareExemption.description: Medicare levy exemption claimed. Default none.

medicareFamily.description: Medicare levy variation declaration (lower withholding for low-income families).

payDate.description: Pay date (YYYY-MM-DD). Picks the financial year's tables; overrides taxYear.

seniors.description: Claims the seniors and pensioners tax offset with this status (uses Schedule 9).

studyLoan.description: Has a HELP, VSL, SSL or other study and training support loan. Default false.

taxFreeThreshold.description: Tax-free threshold claimed with this employer. Default true (main job). Use false for a second job.

taxYear.description: Australian financial year (1 July to 30 June) whose withholding tables to use. Default 2026-27.

tfnProvided.description: Employee gave their tax file number. Default true. False applies the no-TFN rate.

name: payg_withholding
title: PAYG withholding for one pay
